product_title: Royal Red Shubh Labh Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Add a divine touch to your home with this handcrafted red and gold toran, featuring a Krishna motif, sacred cow designs, Shubh Labh accents, and intricate pearl embellishments. Perfect for decorating main entrances, pooja rooms, and festive spaces during Diwali, weddings, and special celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearl strings and decorative tassels carefully.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
